title: Basic Class Definition and Object Creation
description: Create a class and an object, assign values, and print them.
constraints: Define a class Car with public members brand (string) and year (int). Create an object in main and print its data.
explanation: The output shows the assigned brand and year for the Car object.

title: Class with Member Function
description: Define a class with a member function and demonstrate object behavior.
constraints: Define a class Dog with private member name (string), and public methods: constructor, bark(), set_name(), get_name(). Demonstrate their use in main.
sampleOutput:
Buddy says Woof!
Max says Woof!
explanation: The output comes from calling bark() after setting the dog's name.

title: Using `this` Pointer in a Class
description: Show use of the this pointer to distinguish member variables from parameters.
constraints: Define a class Point with private x and y. Use this-> in the constructor. Print the coordinates.
explanation: The output displays the coordinates of the Point object.

title: Constructors and Destructors
description: Demonstrate object creation and destruction with appropriate messages.
constraints: Define a class ResourceUser with a constructor and destructor. Each prints a message when called.
sampleOutput:
ResourceUser object created.
ResourceUser object created.
ResourceUser object destroyed.
ResourceUser object destroyed.
explanation: The output shows the order of construction and destruction for two objects.

title: Encapsulation with Getters and Setters
description: Practice encapsulation using private variables and public getter and setter methods.
constraints: Define a class BankAccount with private double balance. Implement constructor, deposit, withdraw, and get_balance (const). Check for valid input in all methods.
sampleOutput:
Initial balance: $1000.00
Depositing $200.00. New balance: $1200.00
Withdrawing $300.00. New balance: $900.00
Attempted to withdraw $1000.00. Insufficient funds.
Current balance: $900.00
explanation: The output shows the result of deposit, withdraw, and balance checks.

title: Static Member Variables and Functions
description: Use static members to count the number of objects created.
constraints: Define class Counter with private static int count. Increment count in the constructor. Provide static int get_count().
sampleOutput:
Counter object created.
Counter object created.
Counter object created.
Total Counter objects created: 3
explanation: The output shows constructor messages and the count of objects.

title: Copy Constructor and Assignment Operator
description: Implement copy constructor and assignment operator for a class that manages a string.
constraints: Define class MyString with private std::string data. Implement constructor, copy constructor, assignment operator, and print(). Print a message in copy constructor and assignment operator.
sampleOutput:
Initial string: Hello
Copy constructor called.
Copied string (s2): Hello
Assignment operator called.
Assigned string (s3): Hello
Copy constructor called.
Passed by value: Hello
explanation: The output shows messages for copy and assignment operations.

title: Friend Functions for Non-Member Access
description: Use a friend function to access private members of a class.
constraints: Define a class Wallet with private double balance. Declare friend void display_wallet_balance(const Wallet& w).
explanation: The output comes from the friend function accessing the private balance.

title: Constant Objects and Member Functions
description: Demonstrate usage of const member functions and const objects.
constraints: Define class Book with private title and author. Implement constructor, get_title, get_author, and print_details as const. Provide a non-const function to change the title.
sampleOutput:
Non-const book details:
Title: The Hobbit, Author: J.R.R. Tolkien
Changing title...
New title: The Hobbit (Revised)

Const book details:
Title: 1984, Author: George Orwell
explanation: The output shows details for both const and non-const Book objects.

title: Singleton Pattern (Static Members & Private Constructor)
description: Implement the Singleton design pattern for a logger class.
constraints: Define class Logger with private static Logger* instance_ptr and private constructor. Provide static Logger* get_instance(). Delete copy constructor and assignment operator.
sampleOutput:
Logger instance created.
Logger message: Application started.
Logger message: User logged in.
(Note: 'Logger instance created.' appears only once)
explanation: The output shows that only one Logger instance is created and reused.

title: Operator Overloading: `+` for Complex Numbers
description: Overload the + operator as a non-member function for complex number addition.
constraints: Define class Complex with private real and imag. Overload + as a friend non-member. Implement print().
explanation: The output comes from adding and printing complex numbers.

title: Online Store: Product and Shopping Cart Classes
description: Model an online store with Product and ShoppingCart classes and appropriate member functions.
constraints: Define Product and ShoppingCart classes. ShoppingCart uses vector<Product>. Implement all required methods.
sampleOutput:
Created Products:
Name: Laptop, Price: $1200.00
Name: Mouse, Price: $25.50
Name: Keyboard, Price: $75.00

Adding items to cart...
Added Laptop to cart.
Added Mouse to cart.
Added Keyboard to cart.

Cart details:
Name: Laptop, Price: $1200.00
Name: Mouse, Price: $25.50
Name: Keyboard, Price: $75.00
Total price: $1300.50
explanation: The output shows product creation, addition to cart, and total price.
